managed_rule_groups_enabled.title: Managed Rule Groups Enabled
managed_rule_groups_enabled.description: Whether one or more managed rule groups (e.g., AWS Managed Rules, OWASP Core Rule Set) are active on the WAF in enforcement mode

owasp_top10_categories_covered.title: OWASP Top 10 Categories Covered
owasp_top10_categories_covered.description: Count of distinct OWASP Top 10 attack categories for which at least one active rule exists in enforcement mode

rule_action_mode.title: Primary Rule Action Mode
rule_action_mode.description: The predominant action mode of the active rule set — whether rules are actively blocking/preventing matched requests or only logging/counting them

waf_operation_mode.title: WAF Operation Mode
waf_operation_mode.description: The current operational mode of the WAF, determining whether it actively blocks, only detects, or is disabled

false_positive_tuning_enabled.title: False Positive Tuning Enabled
false_positive_tuning_enabled.description: Indicates whether the WAF has been configured with rule tuning, exceptions, or allow-listing to reduce false positives for known-good traffic patterns

anomaly_score_threshold.title: Anomaly Score Threshold
anomaly_score_threshold.description: The configured anomaly score threshold at which requests are blocked. Higher values reduce false positives by requiring more rule matches before blocking.

waf_inline_deployment.title: WAF Deployed Inline
waf_inline_deployment.description: Indicates whether the WAF is positioned inline in the traffic path (e.g., as a reverse proxy or gateway) so that it can physically intercept and drop requests before they reach the web server

active_blocking_rule_count.title: Active Blocking Rule Count
active_blocking_rule_count.description: The number of WAF rules currently configured with a blocking action rather than a logging-only or allow action

inspected_request_components.title: Inspected Request Components
inspected_request_components.description: List of HTTP request components actively evaluated by WAF rules (e.g., HEADERS, URI, QUERY_STRING, POST_BODY, COOKIES)

post_body_inspection_enabled.title: POST Body Inspection Enabled
post_body_inspection_enabled.description: Indicates whether the WAF is configured to inspect HTTP POST request bodies, which is often disabled by default due to performance impact

inspection_rule_coverage_mode.title: Inspection Rule Coverage Mode
inspection_rule_coverage_mode.description: Describes the breadth of the WAF rule set coverage across request components — full, partial, or none

custom_rules_enabled.title: Custom Rules Enabled
custom_rules_enabled.description: Indicates whether the WAF has custom rule creation and enforcement capability activated, allowing administrators to define organization-specific rules beyond default rule sets

active_custom_rule_count.title: Active Custom Rule Count
active_custom_rule_count.description: The number of custom rules currently deployed and enforced in the WAF configuration

custom_rule_enforcement_mode.title: Custom Rule Enforcement Mode
custom_rule_enforcement_mode.description: The operational mode of the custom rules — whether they actively block matching traffic, only detect/log it, or are inactive

logging_enabled.title: WAF Logging Enabled
logging_enabled.description: Whether the WAF is configured to log all inspected requests and enforcement actions

log_detail_level.title: Log Detail Level
log_detail_level.description: The granularity of information captured in WAF logs, indicating whether full request/response context is recorded

log_destination_configured.title: Log Destination Configured
log_destination_configured.description: Whether a persistent, external, or centralized log destination (e.g., SIEM, S3, syslog) is configured to receive WAF logs

logged_event_types.title: Logged Event Types
logged_event_types.description: The categories of events the WAF is configured to log, such as rule_matches, allowed_requests, blocked_requests, and rate_limit_events

rate_limiting_enabled.title: Rate Limiting Enabled
rate_limiting_enabled.description: Indicates whether rate limiting or request throttling rules are actively enabled in the WAF configuration

rate_limit_threshold.title: Rate Limit Request Threshold
rate_limit_threshold.description: The maximum number of requests allowed from a single source within the defined evaluation window before throttling or blocking is triggered

rate_limit_action.title: Rate Limit Enforcement Action
rate_limit_action.description: The action taken by the WAF when a source exceeds the rate limit threshold

tls_inspection_enabled.title: TLS Inspection Enabled
tls_inspection_enabled.description: Whether the WAF is configured to terminate TLS and decrypt HTTPS traffic before applying rule evaluation

https_traffic_inspection_scope.title: HTTPS Traffic Inspection Scope
https_traffic_inspection_scope.description: Defines which HTTPS traffic is subject to decryption and inspection by the WAF

tls_certificate_validation_enabled.title: TLS Certificate Validation Enabled
tls_certificate_validation_enabled.description: Whether the WAF validates TLS certificates during termination, ensuring the inspection chain is not trivially bypassed via invalid certificates

siem_forwarding_enabled.title: SIEM Log Forwarding Enabled
siem_forwarding_enabled.description: Whether WAF events and logs are configured to be forwarded to a SIEM platform (e.g., via syslog, API, or log shipper)

alerting_configured.title: Alerting Rules Configured
alerting_configured.description: Whether alert rules are defined in the SIEM or WAF to trigger notifications on security events (e.g., block events, anomaly thresholds)

auto_update_enabled.title: Automatic Rule Set Updates Enabled
auto_update_enabled.description: Indicates whether the WAF is configured to automatically pull and apply managed rule set updates without manual intervention

rule_set_version_age_days.title: Rule Set Version Age (Days)
rule_set_version_age_days.description: Number of days since the currently active managed rule set version was last updated or refreshed on the WAF

update_notification_configured.title: Update Notification Alerts Configured
update_notification_configured.description: Whether alerting or notification is configured to inform the team when rule set updates are available or have been applied

geo_ip_filtering_enabled.title: Geo-IP Filtering Enabled
geo_ip_filtering_enabled.description: Indicates whether geographic IP-based filtering is active in the WAF configuration, blocking or flagging traffic from high-risk or restricted geographies

ip_reputation_filtering_enabled.title: IP Reputation Filtering Enabled
ip_reputation_filtering_enabled.description: Indicates whether IP reputation-based filtering is active, blocking or flagging traffic from known malicious IP ranges and Tor exit nodes using threat intelligence feeds

threat_feed_update_frequency_days.title: Threat Feed Update Frequency (Days)
threat_feed_update_frequency_days.description: Number of days between updates to the geo-IP and IP reputation threat intelligence feeds used by the WAF

filtering_action_mode.title: Filtering Action Mode
filtering_action_mode.description: The enforcement mode applied when geo-IP or reputation rules are triggered — whether traffic is actively blocked or only logged/alerted
